premises.text: Cyclists and pedestrians face severe nighttime road fatality risk that current safety gear does not adequately address
premises.evidence_span: Every six hours, a motorist hits and kills a cyclist. Even worse, every eight minutes, a pedestrian is killed on U.S. streets alone

premises.text: Traditional safety vests and lights look unattractive and are functionally limited
premises.evidence_span: those traditional safety vests make you look a bit like a walking traffic cone

premises.text: Combined advanced hardware and luminous software optimize lighting cues from ride data for maximum visibility and communication with drivers
premises.evidence_span: This truly optimizes lighting to maximize the visibility

premises.text: College bookstore retail and brand licensing (including smart helmet partners) get luminous gear to users beyond DTC
premises.evidence_span: parents will be able to purchase luminous gear at college bookstores across the US

domains.name: Road safety need and gear stigma

value.text: Keep wearers seen and potentially save their lives
value.evidence_span: These keep you seen and could potentially save your life

secondary_value.text: Enhance user experience by coaching journeys with lighting
secondary_value.evidence_span: uses that information to enhance your own user experience and coach you through these journeys

causal_links.evidence_span: a motorist hits and kills a cyclist
optimizes lighting to maximize the visibility
keep their students safe at night

notes: Demo feature list (turn/brake/pace) folded into hardware-software premise. Fatality stats treated as problem salience with traditional-gear stigma, not as traction. Anti-template note: need/product/channel partition supported by separately revisable market problem, lighting stack, and licensing retail.
